gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-neco: Nanum Pen Script has gaping e mouths and a tight, hand-drawn lean that feels like a friendly scribble. Neco, a serif, swells gently from hairline to stem, and its curves never pinch shut, which gives a few lines a dignified footing.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-plein: Scribbled and cheerful, Nanum Pen Script keeps its joins as thick as its stems, while the plain sans Plein stays crisp and low-contrast beneath. Plein wants brevity, not endless paragraphs.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-recia: Nanum Pen Script draws every line at a marker's constant width, with a hand-made looseness and tightly packed letters. And Recia, a text serif, adds a sharp, faintly modulated stroke, so the strongest thing here is how casual and authoritative sit together.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-rowan: Neon tubing bent into letters is the best picture of Nanum Pen Script, constant in thickness and friendly in its wide e mouths. Rowan, a text serif, brings literary warmth, its light strokes receding only slightly, and that gentle texture is the pair's real charm.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-spline-sans: Nanum Pen Script brings a tightly spaced, hand-drawn friendliness, with gaping mouths on its e shapes, over a body of plain sans. Spline Sans keeps its strokes uniform and wide-gapped.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-fs-synonym: Loose and hand-drawn, with open-mouthed e shapes and tightly packed letters, Nanum Pen Script is the one with the personality. Synonym, a sans, simply lays down a constant stripe of ink with generous curves, built for brief stretches of reading.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-outfit: Outfit is a plain sans of cable-like curves that stop short of closing. Nanum Pen Script handles the headline with its handwritten, tightly spaced charm, so give Outfit modest sizing and keep it away from long paragraphs.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-plus-jakarta-san: Plus Jakarta Sans builds every letter from a monoline stroke, with curve endings held well apart for a modern, precise look. Nanum Pen Script is the warm, hand-drawn voice up top, while the body does the tidy work of short reading.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-sora: Sora reads as precise and geometric, its curves turning corners without any pressure swell and its c and s kept widely parted. Nanum Pen Script brings the friendly handwriting; Sora handles the short stretches of tidy reading.
gen-gf-nanum-pen-script-space-grotesk: Nanum Pen Script looks hand-drawn and friendly, tightly spaced. Its handwriting gives the headline charm, while Space Grotesk, a plain sans, draws constant-width ribbons with breathing counters and suits brief copy.
